title: The security deposit
condition_label: Agreement on B (predicate dissolves — nothing was earned)
stem: My roommate and closest friend from college, Jonah, and I are moving out of our apartment next month. When we signed the lease we agreed in writing: damage one of us causes comes out of that person's share of the deposit.
